subject.title: Skill publish slugs still collide globally despite publisher scoping

question: Should maintainers close this as fixed for ClawHub publishing, or split/keep it to track the later installed-skill UI ambiguity reported for duplicate slugs?
rationale: Automation can verify the original publish-path fix, but collaborator-authored items are protected from cleanup close and the latest human comment describes a possibly separate OpenClaw UI symptom.

options.title: Split UI Ambiguity
options.body: Manually resolve the ClawHub publish part and track the installed-skill `skill.not_found` behavior in the appropriate OpenClaw/ClawHub resolver issue with UI proof.

options.title: Keep Combined
options.body: Leave this issue open as an umbrella until maintainers verify both publish and installed-skill UI behavior are fixed.

recommendation.title: Split UI Ambiguity
recommendation.body: Manually resolve the ClawHub publish part and track the installed-skill `skill.not_found` behavior in the appropriate OpenClaw/ClawHub resolver issue with UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the current issue and the merged owner-scoped implementation, so they have the clearest context for whether the later UI symptom should be split.
